ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area exceeding 95%, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in localized linear and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base layer across 100% of visible surface. High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the left and right distal tips. Discontinuous white linear streaks distributed across both lobes, with a primary concentration in the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 90 degrees and a depth approximately 1/8th of the total lobe vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the superior boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixels) alternating with shallow valleys across the lateral span of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the distal-superior edge, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-intensity white/grey pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 parallel, high-contrast white diagonal lines (rake marks) in the lower-left quadrant; numerous independent horizontal and diagonal white linear disruptions scattered across the central surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring on the left lobe; significant barnacle colonization clusters at the lobe tips causing high-contrast texture deviation.
other_distinctive_markers: Single high-intensity white focal spot (approximately circular) located immediately to the right of the median notch apex.
